senses.gloss: त्य॑ See त्य॑द्.
त्य॑—जप (त्य॑-), m. that (i.e. a lower kind of) muttering (opposed to महाजप॑), MaitrS. ii, 9, 1, 12.
त्यग्नायिस् N. of a Sāman, Lāṭy.
2. त्यज् mfn. ifc. leaving, abandoning, W.
giving up, offering, BhP. viii; Rājat. iv
cf. तनु-, तनू-, सु-.
त्यक्त mfn. left, abandoned.
त्यक्त—जीवित mfn. one who has given up all expectation of life, ready to abandon life, Bhag. i, 19; Nal. ii, 16 (in comp.), R. iv.
त्यक्त—पुनः-स्वि-कृत (in rhet.) resuming what has been suspended, Kpr.
त्यक्त—प्राण mfn. id., MBh. v, 7204.
त्यक्त—लज्ज mfn. abandoning shame, shameless, BhP. v, 26, 23.
त्यक्त—वत् mfn. having left.
त्यक्त—विधि mfn. transgressing rules, ix, 6, 9.
त्यक्त—श्री mfn. abandoned by fortune.
त्यक्ताग्नि mfn. (a Brahman) neglecting the household-fire, Mn. iii, 153.
one who has abandoned the sacred fire, Mn. iii, 153.
त्यक्तात्मन् mfn. despairing, Gaut. xv.
त्यक्तव्य mfn. to be left or abandoned, Mn. ix, 239
to be kept off from (abl.), VarBṛS.
to be given up or sacrificed, MBh. i, 6183 and 6195; R.
to be given up in despair, Subh.
त्यक्तु-काम mfn. wishing to leave.
त्यक्तृ mfn. abandoner of any one (gen.), Mn. iii, 245, Sch.
one who abandons or sacrifices (his life, प्राणान्), MBh. vii, 378.
त्यज See दुस्-.
त्यजन n. leaving, abandoning, W.
giving, W.
excepting, exclusion, W.
expelling, AV.Paipp. xix, 12, 4.
त्याजन n. abandoning (worldly attachments, सङ्गानाम्), BhP. xi, 20, 26.
त्यजनीय mfn. to be left or abandoned, W.
to be avoided or excepted, W.
त्य॑जस् n. abandonment, difficulty, danger, RV.
alienation, aversion, envy (= क्रोध, Naigh. ii, 13), RV.
त्य˚ज॑स् m. ‘offshoot’, a descendant, x, 10, 3.
त्यजित mfn. = त्यक्त, Hariv. ii, 2, 22.
त्याजित mfn. made to abandon (with acc.), Kathās. lxxxvi, 13
made to give up, MārkP. lxxxix, 19
deprived of (acc.), MBh. xiii; Kum. vii, 14; Megh. &c.
expelled, Pañcad. iii, 60
caused to be disregarded, Ragh. vi, 56.
त्याग॑ m. (Pāṇ. vi, 1, 216) leaving, abandoning, forsaking, Mn. &c.
quitting (a place, देश-), Pañcat.
discharging, secretion, MBh. xiv, 630; VarBṛS. giving up, resigning, gift, donation, distribution, KātyŚr.; Mn. &c.
sacrificing one's life, RV. iv, 24, 3
liberality, Mn. ii, 97; R. &c.
a sage, L.
cf. आत्म-, तनु-, देह-, प्राण-, शरीर-.
त्याग—गता f. N. of a Nāga virgin, Kāraṇḍ. i, 47.
त्याग—युत mfn. liberal, Laghuj.
त्याग—शील mfn. id.
त्याग—शील—ता f. liberality, Hit.
त्यागिन् mfn. (Pāṇ. iii, 2, 142) = त्याजक, Mn. iii, 245 (with gen.), Yājñ. & Śak. v, 28 (ifc.)
giving up, resigning (ifc.), Bhag. xviii, 11
one who has resigned (as an ascetic who abandons worldly objects), MBh. iii, 77
sacrificing, giving up (life, आत्मनः), Mn. 89
liberal, (m.) donor, R. vi; Pañcat.; Kathās.
त्यागिन् m. a hero, L.
त्या˚गि-ता f. liberality, Hit. i.
त्यागिम mfn., W.
त्याजक mfn. one who abandons or expels, Yājñ. ii, 198.
त्याज्य mfn. (Pāṇ. vii, 3, 66, Vārtt.) to be left or abandoned or quitted or shunned or expelled or removed, Mn. ix, 83; MBh. &c.
to be given up, Bhag. &c.
to be sacrificed, Daś. vii, 211
to be excepted, W.
त्याज्य n. part of an asterism or its duration considered as unlucky, W.

त्य॑द् mfn. nom. स्य॑ (स्), स्या॑, त्य॑द्, (g. सर्वादि) that (often used like an article, e.g. त्य॑त् पणीनां॑ व॑सु, ‘that i.e. the wealth of the Paṇis’, RV. ix, 111, 2; sometimes strengthened by चि॑द्; often put after उत॑, or after another demonstrative in the beginning of a sentence), RV.; AV. vii, 14, 1; ŚBr. xiv (त्य॑स्य = म॑म, 4, 1, 26; n. त्य॑म् for त्य॑द्, 5, 3, 1 and [in the etymology of सत्य॑म्] KauṣUp.), TUp. ii, 6
त्य॑द् ind. indeed, namely, as it is known (always preceded by ह), RV.
त्यद् [cf. Old Germ. der.]
त्यत्र ind. ‘there’
त्यत्र—त्य mfn. being there, Vop. vii, 111.
त्यदम् ind. ifc. = त्यद्, g. शरद्-आदि.
त्याद m. (patr. fr. त्यद्) the son of that person, Pāṇ. iv, 1, 156; Siddh.
त्यादायनि m. id., ib. (त्यद्˚ ed., but cf. ताद्˚, याद्˚).
त्यादृश् mfn. such a one as that, iii, 2, 60.
त्यादृ˚श mfn. such a one as that, iii, 2, 60.
